title: Introduction to jtbdtools
text: Jobs---Done (JTBD) theory says customers “hire” products get job done. Outcome-Driven Innovation (ODI), developed Tony Ulwick, turns quantitative framework: survey users important outcome satisfied current solutions, calculate biggest gaps . opportunity score formula: importance exceeds satisfaction, gap amplifies opportunity. satisfaction exceeds importance, opportunity equals importance (floor). Scores range 0-20, anything 10 considered high-opportunity outcome.
